output: {"answers":{"d05":"阳性不等于大概率患病，贝叶斯公式算的正是这件事。设患病率1%，查1000人：约10人患病、990人健康。检测对病人99%报阳性，约10人；对健康人也有5%误报，约50人。阳性共约60人，真患病的只占10/60≈17%。为什么99%准确的检测得出17%？因为健康人基数大，小比例误报也人数可观。公式为 P(患病|阳性)=P(阳性|患病)×患病率÷P(阳性)：分子是「病人且被检出」的人数，分母是全部阳性人数。注意方向：P(阳性|患病)=99%问的是病人里多少被查出，我们要的是反过来。条件变化：若人群患病率升到10%（如医院就诊者），同样99%的检测，阳性中真患病约 (0.099)/(0.099+0.045)≈69%——同一结果的意义随基础比例改变。","d03":"正反馈是输出反过来加强输入的循环：变化每绕一圈都被放大，微小差异会滚成大变化。麦克风靠近音箱：声音被拾取、放大、播出、再拾取，几秒内变成啸叫；复利同理，利息计入本金后增长越来越快。两点要分清。第一，「正」指方向同向增强，不是好坏：负反馈拉回原状（空调恒温），带来稳定；正反馈离开原状，可能是爆炸增长，也可能是挤兑崩塌。第二，放大有边界：啸叫受功放功率封顶，挤兑受存款总量限制。条件变化：若环路中每圈只传递一半信号，增益小于1，循环反而收敛——所以正反馈是否危险，取决于绕一圈的增益是否大于1。","v08":"Little's law: L = λW. In steady state, the average number of customers in a system (L) equals the arrival rate (λ) times the average time each spends there (W). Example: a coffee shop gets 2 customers per minute and each stays 5 minutes (queue + service), so on average 2×5 = 10 people are inside. Its power is that it needs no assumptions about arrival or service distributions — just long-run averages at steady state. Each symbol answers a different question: how many are inside, how fast they arrive, how long one stays; know any two, derive the third. Condition change: if staffing cuts the stay to 2.5 minutes while arrivals stay 2/min, L drops to 5. Watch the direction: W counts total time in the system, not just service time.","v03":"自然选择改变种群，靠的是「随机变异＋差异繁殖」，不需要任何个体主动努力。长颈鹿不是把脖子拉长的：古代鹿群的脖子长短本有随机差异，脖子稍长的个体在树叶稀少时吃得更多、活得更久、留下更多后代，后代继承长脖基因，种群平均脖长逐代上升。个体一生的性状不变，被改变的是哪些基因被留下——选择像筛子，不像教练。两个误解要澄清：变异是随机的，不是环境「逼」出来的；「适者」只指留下更多可育后代，未必更强壮。条件变化：若环境以低矮灌木为主，脖长不再影响繁殖成败，这个性状的选择压力消失，种群也不再朝长颈方向移动。","v06":"Deadlock is a standstill where each process holds a resource and waits for another's, so none can ever proceed. Example: thread A acquires lock1, then requests lock2; thread B acquires lock2, then requests lock1. A waits for B, B waits for A, neither releases what it holds — both freeze forever. Four conditions must all hold: mutual exclusion (one owner per resource), hold-and-wait, no preemption (resources can't be forcibly taken back), and a circular chain of waiting. Break any one and deadlock becomes impossible. In practice the easiest fix is ordering: every thread acquires locks in the same global order (always lock1 before lock2), which makes a cycle impossible. Condition change: if A happens to grab lock2 first, both proceed — deadlock depends on ordering and timing, not on code that obviously looks wrong.","v05":"信息熵衡量「平均每次结果有多难猜」。公式 H=−Σp·log₂p：每种可能的「意外程度」取其概率的负对数，再按概率加权平均。均匀硬币：H=−2×0.5×log₂0.5=1比特。偏硬币（正面0.9、反面0.1）：H≈0.47比特。为什么均匀更不确定？猜偏硬币时，90%的次数押「正面」就对了，平均意外很小；均匀硬币每回都五五开，你一直在猜，平均信息量最大。极端情形印证：结果必然发生（概率1）时熵为0，毫无不确定性。条件变化：概率从0.9/0.1移向0.5/0.5，熵单调上升，最大值为log₂n（n为可能数）；离开均匀，不确定性必然减小。","v01":"过拟合就是「把题目背下来了，但没学会方法」。预测模型训练时见过带答案的例题；好的学习是从中提炼规律，过拟合则是连噪音和巧合一起记死。判断办法很直接：训练数据上表现极好，换成没见过的新数据就明显变差。极端例子：拟合房价时，模型记住了「第7套房旁有棵树所以贵2万」这种无关细节，新房没有第7套的树，预测就崩。为什么发生：模型太灵活而数据太少，容量足以去记而非学。条件变化：数据增多后巧合无法被全部记住，过拟合减轻；限制模型复杂度也能逼它只学主要规律。所以训练准确率高不等于模型好，必须看新数据上的表现。","d01":"似然和后验回答两个不同的问题，方向别搞反。似然问：假设某假设为真，看到眼前这批数据的可能性多大，记作P(数据|假设)；后验问：看到数据后，这假设成立的概率多大，P(假设|数据)。例子：连抛3次全是正面。若硬币公平，P(3正|公平)=(1/2)³=1/8；若两面都是正面，P(3正|全正)=1。这两个都是似然，用来比较假设，不是假设为真的概率。别因此断定硬币必是全正面：后验还要乘上先验。全正面硬币本就极罕见，设P(全正)=1/1000，后验≈(1×0.001)/(1×0.001+1/8×0.999)≈0.008，仍很小。贝叶斯公式就是「似然×先验」归一化后得到后验。数据固定不动，变动的是假设——这正是似然的用法。","d07":"相关只说明两个量一起变动；因果还要求改变一个会带动另一个。例子：冰淇淋销量与溺水人数同涨同跌，相关很强，但禁售冰淇淋救不了人——真正原因是气温：天热既让人多吃冰淇淋，也让人多下水，这叫混杂变量。判断方法是问一句：「如果我干预其中一个，另一个会变吗？」只比较同样热的日子（控制气温），冰淇淋与溺水的相关基本消失，因果链断了；而吸烟与肺癌在控制年龄等干扰后关联仍在，加上剂量关系与机理证据，因果判断才成立。条件变化：若出现第三个变量同时解释两者，相关就只是它留下的影子。记住：因果必相关，相关未必因果。","d02":"Variance measures how far numbers spread around their average. Recipe: take each value's distance from the mean, square it, average the squares. Example: scores {2, 4, 6}. Mean = 4; distances −2, 0, +2; squares 4, 0, 4; variance = 8/3 ≈ 2.67. Why square the distances? Raw distances always sum to zero (−2+0+2=0) — positives and negatives cancel, hiding the spread. Squaring also punishes big deviations hard: change 6 to 10 and variance jumps from 2.67 to about 11.6, while the mean only moves from 4 to 5.3. The cost: units get squared (points²), so we usually take the square root — the standard deviation — to return to original units. Two classes with the same mean but very different variances are very different in consistency.","d08":"Compound growth means growth earns growth: each period's gain is added to the base, so the next gain is bigger. $1,000 at 10%: year 1 → $1,100; year 2 → $1,210; year 3 → $1,331. After n years: 1000 × 1.1ⁿ — each year multiplies rather than adds. Why the starting amount matters: multiplication is proportional, so the same rate on $2,000 doubles every result ($2,662 vs $1,331 after 3 years) with zero extra effort. Time compounds the same way: the last decade of a 40-year investment dwarfs the first, because late gains act on a large base. Condition change: at 5% instead of 10%, $1,000 reaches only about $1,158 in 3 years — rate, base, and time each enter multiplicatively, so none can be judged alone.","d06":"Cache invalidation is deciding when a stored copy of data is too stale to serve. A web app keeps the product price in memory so pages render without hitting the database. The risk: the price changes in the database, but the cache still says $50, so customers see outdated data. Strategies trade freshness against speed. TTL: expire entries after, say, 60 seconds — simple, but up to a minute of staleness. Write-through: update or delete the cache entry whenever the database is written — fresher, but every write pays extra cost, and a missed write leaves stale data anyway. The hard part is you can't always know when underlying data changed, hence the joke that cache invalidation is one of the two hard problems in CS. Condition change: rarely-changing data (product titles) tolerates long TTLs; flash-sale prices need immediate invalidation.","v04":"Idempotency means performing the same operation multiple times has the same effect as performing it once. It matters in distributed systems because networks are unreliable: a request times out, the client retries, but the first request may already have succeeded. Compare: \"set balance to $100\" is idempotent — retrying is harmless; \"add $10 to balance\" is not — each retry moves money again. Real-world case: payment APIs issue an idempotency key; the client sends the same key on retries, and the server recognizes the duplicate and returns the stored result instead of charging twice. Condition change: idempotency holds within a scope (one key, one operation), and the server must remember processed keys — that storage is the price you pay for making retries safe.","v02":"Precision and recall grade a search engine from two sides. A query returns 20 documents, 15 of them relevant. Precision = 15/20 = 75%: of what we returned, how much was worth returning. If the corpus actually holds 30 relevant documents, recall = 15/30 = 50%: of everything worth finding, how much did we surface. They pull against each other: return all million documents and recall hits 100% while precision collapses; return only the single safest hit and precision may be 100% with tiny recall. Which matters more depends on the task: legal discovery wants high recall (missing evidence is costly); a web search's first page wants high precision (users won't scroll). One number measures trustworthiness of results, the other measures how much was missed.","d04":"机会成本是你为选中的事付出的「最好的那个被放弃的选项」。周五下午空闲，可选看电影、复习、睡觉：选看电影的机会成本不是其他全部选项之和，而是你第二想做的事——比如复习带来的分数提升。两个常见误区要纠正：以为成本只是票钱——其实时间本身就是成本，免费活动也放弃了别的机会；以为要算上所有备选——只有最好的那个算数，因为你挑的本来就是诸选项中的最优者。条件变化：如果下周就考试，复习的价值大涨，看电影的机会成本随之大涨，同一部电影变得「更贵」。所以理性选择不是问「这值不值」，而是问「它比最好的替代好多少」。","v07":"公共物品是人人可享、一个人多用也不减少别人可用的东西：路灯、国防、烟花表演。两个特征——不付费也拦不住你享用（非排他），你享用不挤占别人（非竞争）。麻烦正出在这里：既然不掏钱也看得见烟花，每个人都想「让别人出钱，我白看」，这就是搭便车。结果人人藏起付费意愿，烟花、路灯、基础研究供给不足——尽管大家合起来其实都想要。这不是人性坏，而是制度下的理性反应，所以应对靠集体分摊：税收养国防，物业费养路灯。条件变化：一旦能排他（有线电视收费、会员制），或人数少到能互相监督（几个邻居凑钱），私人供给就变得可行，问题随之减弱。"}
